{"id":1836911605,"question_id":4128,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763826232,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1836911605/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Total Waviness of Numbers in Range II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long totalWaviness(long long num1, long long num2) {\n        long long peaks = 0;\n        long long valleys = 0;\n        long long waviness = 0;\n        for(int i = num1 ; i<=num2 ; i++){\n            string s = to_string(i);\n            if(s.size() < 3) waviness = 0;\n            for(int j = 1 ; j < s.size()-1 ; j++){\n                if(s[j] > s[j+1] && s[j] > s[j-1])\n                    peaks++;\n                else if(s[j] < s[j+1] && s[j] < s[j-1])\n                    valleys++;\n            }   \n        } \n    waviness = peaks + valleys;\n    return waviness;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"total-waviness-of-numbers-in-range-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1164}
